cohort: 14,595 births to women with diabetes in Missouri between 2000 and 2006, including 7,082 women with a BMI > 30 kg/m2.
finding: Increasing maternal obesity, particularly superobesity (BMI ≥ 50 kg/m2), was associated with significantly increased risks of preeclampsia, macrosomia, and cesarean delivery in women with diabetes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates increased significantly with increasing maternal BMI, particularly in nulliparous women with diabetes.
gest_age: All infants were live-born singletons at ≥ 37 weeks gestation.
